children.blockName: Digital gardener and coffee enthusiast. Writing about the intersection of design, nature, and slow living.

I’m a product designer focused on building calm, durable software for people who think deeply about their work. I currently design at Stripe, where I work on systems that balance clarity, scale, and human intent. Outside of my day job, I write essays on design, technology, and the idea of “digital gardening” — treating knowledge as something cultivated over time rather than broadcast. I’m interested in slow tools, thoughtful interfaces, and products that respect attention. This space is where I publish long-form writing, notes from travel, and reflections on building things that last. When I’m not designing or writing, you’ll usually find me reading, walking, or searching for good coffee.

user = frappe.db.get_value(
    "Cafe User",
    {"handle": frappe.form_dict.handle},
    ["handle", "company", "designation", "bio", "introduction", "user"],
    as_dict=1,
)

if not user:
    raise frappe.PageDoesNotExistError

frappe_user = frappe.db.get_value(
    "User", user.user, ["full_name", "user_image", "first_name", "last_name"], as_dict=1
)

data.can_edit_profile = user.user == frappe.session.user

data.user = {
    **user,
    **frappe_user,
    "handle": f"@{user.handle}",
    "designation": f"{user.designation} at {user.company}"
    if user.designation
    else None,
}

data.all_posts_url = f"/cafe/profile/{user.handle}/posts"

data.education = []
data.work_history = []


all_experiences = frappe.db.get_all(
    "Cafe User Experience",
    filters={
        "parent": user.user,
    },
    fields=[
        "organization",
        "title",
        "description",
        "from_month",
        "from_year",
        "to_month",
        "to_year",
        "is_current",
        "experience_type",
        "parentfield",
    ],
    order_by="from_year desc, from_month desc",
)

# data.experiences=experiences

for exp in all_experiences:
    from_date = (
        f"{exp['from_month']} {exp['from_year']}"
        if exp["from_month"]
        else str(exp["from_year"])
    )

    if exp["is_current"]:
        duration = f"{from_date} - Present"
    else:
        to_date = (
            f"{exp['to_month']} {exp['to_year']}"
            if exp["to_month"]
            else str(exp["to_year"])
            if exp["to_year"]
            else ""
        )
        duration = f"{from_date} - {to_date}" if to_date else from_date

    exp["duration"] = duration
    if exp.experience_type == "Work":
        data.work_history.append(exp)
    else:
        data.education.append(exp)

data.posts = {"data": [], "are_more_than_three": 0}

posts = frappe.db.get_all(
    "Cafe Post",
    fields=[
        "name",
        "title",
        "description",
        "cover_image",
        "reading_time",
        "slug",
        "creation",
    ],
    limit=3,
    filters={
        "owner": user.user,
    },
    order_by="creation desc",
)

for post in posts:
    count = frappe.db.count("Cafe Post Comment", filters={"post": post["name"]})

    if count == 0:
        post["comments_count"] = None
    elif count == 1:
        post["comments_count"] = f"{count} comment"
    else:
        post["comments_count"] = f"{count} comments"

    if post.get("creation"):
        dt = frappe.utils.getdate(post["creation"])
        months = [
            "Jan",
            "Feb",
            "Mar",
            "Apr",
            "May",
            "Jun",
            "Jul",
            "Aug",
            "Sep",
            "Oct",
            "Nov",
            "Dec",
        ]
        post["formatted_date"] = f"{months[dt.month - 1]} {dt.day} {dt.year}"

    post.url = f"/cafe/posts/{post.slug}"

data.posts["data"] = posts
data.posts["are_more_than_three"] = frappe.db.count("Cafe Post") > 3

user = frappe.db.get_value("Cafe User", {"user": frappe.session.user}, "name")

data.page_data = {
    "user": data.user,
    "all_posts_url": data.all_posts_url,
    "posts_length": len(data.posts["data"]),
    "work_history_length": len(data.work_history),
    "education_length": len(data.education),
}
